purpose: Shared compact handoff and dispatch state for parallel agents. Source of truth for ownership, latest outcomes, SHAs, blockers and next actions.

protocol.update_scope: Modify only your own agent entry and shared metadata directly affected. Preserve all other entries.
protocol.history_policy: Append one concise update per completed task or material milestone; retain only newest 3. Keep current_state and next_action current.
protocol.sha_policy: Record exact branch and SHA inspected/changed. CI, preview and tests count only for that exact SHA.
protocol.concurrency: Before every write fetch latest state.json from coordination/agents, use current blob SHA, merge only your entry. On stale SHA/conflict refetch and retry. Never overwrite another agent.
protocol.truthfulness: Separate verified facts, user-reported facts and assumptions. Unknown values must be null or marked unknown.
protocol.security: Never store secrets, tokens, passwords, recovery links, personal data or credential values.
safety: No merge, production changes, external configuration changes, deploys or remote migrations without explicit user authorization for that exact action.
Do not expand scope or modify another agent's ownership.
protocol.handoff: New agents read this file first, inspect live PR/branch state, then continue from active_assignment/current_state/next_action. Historical entries are not proof of current remote state.
protocol.completion: After completing active_assignment, update status/current_state/next_action and append one update. Do not wait for the user to request a JSON update.

dispatch.instruction: These are the current delegated tasks. Each agent should read this file and execute only the assignment matching its own key. User will send a short message: 'Leia o state.json na branch coordination/agents e continue sua tarefa atribuída. Atualize o arquivo após cada marco.'
